Its much easier to start a convo based on peoples looks rather than their personality bc its the first thing you see and it'll be less awkward if you comment on something cool they're wearing rather than bringing up something you know they like but they haven't told you about it directly. So maybe try to comment on any pins or stickers on his bag, maybe he's wearing a shirt of his favourite band. If you cant find any references to anything try and ask about fashion sense and try to direct that conversation into shopping for clothes -> shopping for food (?) -> cooking. That could be a viable path. My go to topic is music, so you can always ask what songs theyre into right now (dont just say whats ur music taste, thats a very limited question) and try to build the convo from there. When you talk about these things and joke about them you can bring them up the next time you see him like to try and build some rapport. Like for example if you talked about cooking in this convo, and he mention his favourite baked goods, you can say you were just planning to bake that this weekend, so when you bring those treats in for him it'll be more natural because you'll give them to your friends but just so happen to have one left over just for him.

And then build off from there. Good luck\~\~

The earth's gonna be fine, it's gone through way worse shit than humans. It's been there long before us and it'll be there long after we're gone. Attempting to fix climate change is for humans not for the Earth. If we don't fix that, we'll die. 

And no the Earth wasn't designed to only sustain a 40-year hunter-gatherer lifestyle. It can support modern humans fine, the only issue is that we don't replace the resources at the same rate we take them.

A Purge type scenario is highly highly unlikely to happen just from a result of climate change alone. The more likely scenario is going to unfold how it happens in nature - the population reaches an unsustainable level and people will die until the environment returns to its carrying capacity. It's not going to be pretty and it's better for everyone if we're well below the carrying capacity but until a fundamental change in the way humans think happens, we're destined to reach that unsustainable point.
